title: Titanium Plating Rack Spline
system: Electroplating Anode Baskets & Current Delivery Systems
function: Spring-loaded spline contact (V-prong) for PCB rack
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this plating rack application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by spring-loaded spline contact (v-prong) for pcb rack and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for plating rack geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with SPC sampling
Pickling and passivation with SPC sampling
Continuity test <1 mOhm with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for springloaded spline contact application
inspection: Adhesion tape ASTM D3359 (springloaded spline verified)
commonFailures: Contact burn at rack hook from insufficient clamp - resolved by BeCu spring contact 5N minimum force — critical for springloaded spline contact performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Plating Rack Spline suitable for Spring-loaded spline contact (V-prong) for PCB rack?
faq.a: Titanium Plating Rack Spline uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address plating rack operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Plating Rack Spline?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Plating Rack Spline is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for springloaded spline contact requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Plating Rack Spline require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. springloaded spline contact components require Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for springloaded spline contact application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Plating Rack Spline shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Plating Rack Spline includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet springloaded spline contact specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Spline / V-prong plating rack components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
